method: Interpreted July2023 municipal whole-Donner description using actual November2026 OSM Kapos, Zselic-patak, Szigetvári utca and road67/Zselici arcs. Distinct Donner identity is supported separately from eastern Rómahegy. Two common OSM nodes and two analytical bridge-crossing intersections; all other vertices and node-ref connections are original source geometry. The printed source is malformed and route-age/spelling equivalence remains inferred. No compound-map cloning, fabricated child boundary, missing-edge connection, snapping, buffer, hull, frame closure or municipal clipping.
